passos: Forearm against the door frame, elbow at shoulder height
Take a small step forward with the leg on the same side
Turn your torso to the opposite side until you feel the chest stretch
cuidados: Do not push the shoulder forward
If your hand tingles, lower the elbow

peito-maos-atras.nome: Chest stretch with hands clasped behind
passos: Standing, clasp your hands behind your back
Straighten your arms and draw your shoulder blades back
Open the chest and lift your hands slightly
cuidados: Keep the neck long, without lifting the chin
Do not arch the lower back

passos: Hold a fixed support at waist height with both hands
Take two steps back and push your hips back
Keep your arms straight and let your chest sink until you feel your back stretch
cuidados: Knees slightly bent
The support must be secure

passos: Standing, feet hip-width apart
Take one arm over your head
Lean your torso to the opposite side until you feel the side of your back stretch
cuidados: Lean to the side, without twisting the torso
Breathe out as you lean

passos: Kneeling, sit back on your heels
Reach your arms forward and rest your hands on the floor
Let your chest sink towards your thighs and breathe slowly
cuidados: Put a cushion between your thighs and heels if it is uncomfortable
Spread your knees if your belly does not fit

passos: Take one arm straight across your chest
With the other hand, pull it by the elbow towards your chest
Keep the shoulder down, away from the ear
cuidados: Pull at the elbow, not the hand
No pain at the front of the shoulder

ombro-toalha.nome: Overhead shoulder stretch with a towel
passos: Hold a towel with your hands wide apart
Raise your straight arms above your head
Take them slightly back only until you feel tension in the shoulders
cuidados: The wider the hands, the easier it is
Do not arch the lower back

passos: Side-on to the wall, place your palm on it at shoulder height, fingers pointing back
Arm straight
Slowly turn your body away until you feel the front of the arm stretch
cuidados: Elbow straight but not locked
Stop if you feel it in the shoulder

biceps-banco.nome: Biceps stretch with hands behind on a bench
passos: Back to a bench or table, put your hands behind you, palms down
Arms straight
Bend your knees a little to lower your body until you feel the biceps
cuidados: Go down only a little; the tension should be mild
Keep your chest open

passos: Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow, hand towards your back
With the other hand, gently push the elbow back
Keep your head upright
cuidados: Do not force the elbow behind your head
Can be done seated

triceps-parede.nome: Triceps stretch with elbow on a wall
passos: Facing the wall, bend one arm and rest the elbow on the wall above your head
The hand drops behind your head
Lean your chest towards the wall until you feel the back of the arm
cuidados: Small movement
No shoulder pain

passos: Put one hand on a wall for balance
Bend one knee and hold your foot or ankle behind you
Bring your knees together and push your hips slightly forward
cuidados: If you cannot reach your foot, use a towel
Do not pull the heel hard against the glute

passos: One knee on the floor (on a cushion) and the other foot in front
Squeeze the glute of the back leg
Slowly move your hips forward until you feel the front of the hip and thigh
cuidados: Torso upright, without arching the lower back
The front knee stays over the ankle

passos: Lie on your side with your head resting on your arm
Bend the top knee and hold your foot
Take the thigh slightly back until you feel the front of the thigh
cuidados: Knees in line
Use a towel if you cannot reach your foot

posteriores-calcanhar.nome: Hamstring stretch with heel on a step
passos: Rest your heel on a low step, leg straight
Back straight, hands on hips
Lean forward from the hips until you feel the back of the thigh
cuidados: Keep your back straight; rounding it does not stretch the thigh more
Standing knee slightly bent

posteriores-deitado-toalha.nome: Lying hamstring stretch with a towel
passos: Lying on your back, loop a towel around the sole of one foot
Raise the straight leg holding the towel
The other leg stays bent with the foot on the floor
cuidados: Lower back stays on the floor
Raise only until you feel tension

passos: Sitting on the floor, one leg straight and the other bent with the foot against the thigh
Back straight
Lean over the straight leg from the hips
cuidados: Bring your chest to your knee, not your head
Stop if you feel it in the lower back

passos: Lying on your back, knees bent
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee
Pull the bottom thigh towards your chest until you feel the glute of the crossed side
cuidados: Head and shoulders relaxed on the floor
No knee pain

gluteo-cadeira.nome: Seated glute stretch on a chair
passos: Sitting at the edge of a chair, cross one ankle over the opposite knee
Back straight
Lean your torso forward until you feel the glute
cuidados: Press the crossed knee only lightly
Good to do anywhere

passos: Hands on the wall, one leg in front and the other behind
The back leg stays straight with the heel on the floor
Move your hips towards the wall until you feel the calf
cuidados: Back foot pointing forward
Heel always on the floor

passos: Same position as the previous stretch, with the feet closer together
Bend both knees
Keep the back heel on the floor until you feel the lower part of the leg
cuidados: Stretches the deeper muscle (soleus)
Small movement

passos: Ball of one foot on the edge of a step, holding a handrail
Let the heel drop below the step
Keep the knee straight without locking it
cuidados: Always hold the handrail
Lower slowly

passos: Lying face down, hands beside your shoulders
Push the floor away and lift your chest, hips on the floor
Lift only until you feel your belly stretch, with no lower-back pain
cuidados: Shoulders away from the ears
You can stay on your forearms to make it gentler

passos: Lying on your back, arms out in a cross
Bend your knees and let them fall to one side
Keep your shoulders on the floor and look the other way
cuidados: Slow movement
Put a cushion under your knees if they do not reach the floor

passos: On your hands and knees
As you breathe out, round your back and bring your chin to your chest
As you breathe in, let your belly drop and look ahead; alternate slowly for the time shown
cuidados: Gentle movement, within what does not hurt
Hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips
